description: ADR-0049 D9: the default of every `x-leyline-fail-closed` field as last released, and its loosening value. `verify_deployment_config_schema` fails when a schema's default differs from this baseline; moving a default to its `loose` value is `config.leyline/v2`, never a v1 change. A narrowing updates this file in the same pull request, with a Breaking CHANGELOG entry.
